basic_info.description: Spectacular remodeled, top floor condo located on a tranquil, tree-lined street just steps to the lively Cole St corridor. This light filled home has the perfect blend of modern conveniences & incredible Edwardian charm. Expansive living room w/tray ceiling detail, dramatic brick fireplace & bay window. Spacious open dining room, also with tray ceiling detail, leads directly to the thoughtfully remodeled, designer kitchen with stone countertops,  built-in desk + Sub-Zero fridge, gas range & breakfast bar! Private living quarters are ideally located at the back of the unit & include a stunning primary suite with large walk-in closet and remodeled marble bath w/double sink vanity, heated floors, Porcelanosa tile & glass enclosed shower stall. The spacious guest bedroom boasts an oversized closet and is served by the hall bath w/soaking tub and heated tile floors. Inviting, level shared yard with patio, firepit & BBQ, ideal for entertaining. Recent Unit upgrades: 9 newer windows, newer washer/dryer & stove, monkeybrains internet & updated security system. HOA replaced roof (Aug 2025) repaired exterior stairs and painted most of the building exterior. One car garage parking + in-unit laundry room. Enjoy the best of Cole Street cafes, shops and nearby Golden Gate Park.
